title: Extract Formatter and Analyzer traits from Rust string-utils struct
description: A Rust string-utils library needs to be split into composable traits so different formatting and analysis strategies can be mixed.

required_artifacts: pub trait TextAnalyzer with word_count method
pub trait TextFormatter with capitalize method
impl TextAnalyzer for str and impl TextFormatter for str
pub fn describe<T: TextAnalyzer + TextFormatter>(text: &T) -> String
success_criteria: Generic describe function uses trait bounds
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test` to confirm no regressions from your refactor. Also review the code you changed — any remaining duplication, long functions, or unclear names to clean up?
Final pass: run `cargo test` and confirm everything is green. Give me a one-line summary of what changed.
